note: Union County NM publishes no queryable zoning district service. County maps page lists only general PDF maps and ordinances; the county GIS Parcel Viewer (UnionGIS) is a parcel tool with no zoning layer. A 'Zoning Map' ArcGIS Experience (attributed to the Town of Clayton) exists, but its underlying service could not be identified from the web app, and no Clayton zoning FeatureServer appears in ArcGIS Online search. Searches for Des Moines, Mosquero and Tucumcari zoning services found nothing official.
